about_the_game:
Battle grinning gremlins and hulking humanoids with the RPG Monsters Asset Pack 3! Elv Games continues their front view enemy series with 90 more pixel art images to fill out your troops with new creatures. 18 new monster designs are ready to add more combat possibilities to your fights, with muscular-armed monsters that can slam your heroes into the ground with powerful punches, bird-like creatures that can blast your heroes with wind magic from their green crystal wings, and insectoid bipedal beasts that slash with sharp orange spikes! Teach your players how to defeat physically strong foes by sending them against short monsters that focused solely on their arms and skipped leg day, and then test them with boss battles where towering ogres and armored creatures offer up stronger versions of the punches and strikes the smaller enemies used. Have your heroes find rare lizards that have crystals on their head that sell for a lot of gold, or create side quests where mischievous antennaed gremlins need to be defeated to help the local farmers.

Each enemy comes in 5 color variations (4 base colors and 1 glowing green version), so you can make your battles even more intriguing! Use the brown, green, black, and red beefy ogres to show their elemental weaknesses, or have the sharp-toothed round gremlin be white, purple, or black randomly so that each encounter feels brand new. If you’ve been looking for more front view enemies for your heroes to fight, check out the RPG Monsters Asset Pack 3!


Contents:

- Turn Based RPG Monsters for your game!
- Earth & Ghost Monsters!
- 18 Total Monsters!
- 5 Color Variations per Monster!
- 90 Total Monsters!
- 192x192 Pixel Sprites!
- .PNG file format!


Terms of Use:

This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.
OK to be used in Commercial projects
Contents can be edited
OK for use in games with gore
OK for use in adult-rated games
